title: Clinical Wellness
specs: Regulated healthcare professionals registered with the College of Massage Therapists of Ontario

blurb: Guests receive personalized Registered Massage Therapy tailored to their needs and treatment goals. Sessions include assessment and treatment plans by a regulated healthcare professional.
